h1: Watersound "Beach Blessings" 39 W. Yacht Pond Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- 500 yards to the beach- 4-passenger golf cart- Propane grill- 6 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Located in the private, gated community of WaterSound, "Beach Blessings" is a spacious 6-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home and carriage house that can sleep 14. It's only 500 yards away from unobstructed beach access from Deer Lake State Park, easily accessible by the home's golf cart or bikes. Find a ping pong and pool table in the garage and rinse off in the outdoor shower after a long day at the beach. The open kitchen and living room are the perfect place for everyone to sit back and relax. The chef's kitchen has 2 ovens, stainless steel appliances, and a bar area. The dining table can seat 8 for a meal. The primary bedroom is down the hall and features a king bed and attached bathroom with a shower. There is also a queen bedroom with a shared bathroom.An additional living area is on the second floor that opens up to a porch with more seating. There are also 3 guest rooms on this floor. The first features a queen bed that shares a bathroom with the king guest room next door. There is also a bunk room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed and 2 twin built-in beds. The spiral staircase leads to a third-floor loft with wooded views and more seating space.Don't miss your chance to stay at "Beach Blessings" and book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk bed and Two Twin BedsCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
